ref: ADR-0008 "JSON as a source at run time" (spec-4 grilling, 2026-11-05: numbers keep their input spelling; Saxon-HE 12.5's json-to-xml keeps it, observed 2026-11-05); #98
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. The array of numbers $/numbers in the root's one context: each number is written as the input spells it, 1.50 with its trailing zero, 1e2 with its exponent, -0.0 with its sign, and a 20-digit decimal whole. A reading through xs:decimal or xs:double would give 1.5, 100, 0 and a rounded number.
